fixed: When you import a Caller's Companion title filed with its article at the end, such as "Baby Rose, The", you get "The Baby Rose". This covers The, A, An, La, Le, Les and L'.
When you import a dance you already have, "Bastringue, La" and "La Bastringue" now count as the same title.

added: `frontTrailingArticle` moves a trailing `, The`/`A`/`An`/`La`/`Le`/`Les`/`L'` to the front of a title, keeping up to four bracketed annotations at the end.
changed: `mapCallersCompanionDance` and both Caller's Companion adapters' discovery labels front a trailing article.

`DedupeIndex` and `ImportPipeline.autoResolveAmbiguous` match titles on the new `dedupeTitleKeys`: the title as written and with any trailing article fronted. `normalizeTitle`, the sync title key, is unchanged.
The `cc_missing_title` diagnostic no longer says the dance was pasted, since a `.USR` row reaches it too.
